critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.js uses recharts PieChart and BarChart components correctly
Dashboard stats API returns warehouse_chart with computed inventory values per warehouse
Due date notifications show per-invoice items with supplier_name, purchase_number, due_date, remaining
Canvassers.js merged Armada tab using tab state to toggle between canvassers and vehicles views
POS.js fetches daily summary from /api/pos/daily-summary and displays in colored cards
POS product cards compute HPP per unit as cost_price / items_per_box
POS Transfer Stok dialog uses existing /api/stock-transfers endpoint
Reports.js uses jspdf with autoTable import from jspdf-autotable for PDF export
Reports CSV export uses BOM (UTF-8 signature) and Blob for proper Excel compatibility
CSV includes headline (UD. AQIN TANI, period) and totals row
seed_data_creation: Used existing data: 2 vehicles (Mobil Box 1, Mobil Box 2), 1 canvasser (SAHIDIN), transactions from 2026-03-02, 2 purchases with due dates in March 2026
